What each edition can do

Kiboto runs in three ways. This page says what each can do today, and what is still on its way.

Kiboto Companion beside another NAS system

The container on Unraid, TrueNAS SCALE, Proxmox, FygoOS, UGOS or ZettOS. That system keeps running the drives and the machine.

Kiboto Companion on plain Linux

The container on Debian, Ubuntu or any Docker host with no NAS system of its own.

Kiboto OS

A machine of its own: Debian 13 set up by the Kiboto OS install image. Kiboto runs the drives and the machine. In beta.

Keep your NAS system: Companion beside it. A Linux machine with Docker and no NAS system: Companion on plain Linux. A machine you give to Kiboto entirely, with a system disk of its own: Kiboto OS. Companion can move to Kiboto OS later, with its pools and a settings backup. How to choose, and how to move.

  • Yes Kiboto does it.
  • Partly Kiboto does part of it; the note says which part.
  • View only Kiboto shows it; the NAS system changes it.
  • Your NAS system does this The NAS system or the Linux beside Kiboto does it, in its own settings.
  • Not yet Not there yet on this edition; it is being built.
  • Being checked Built, and still being checked on this edition.
  • No Not offered here.
